findings.claim: The test titled 'shows the active chain threshold' only sets item-level threshold/owner numbers while leaving the per-chain threshold/owners fields empty, so it would not catch a regression where the trigger reads chains[n].threshold instead of the item-level value. Giving the per-chain entries different values and asserting the item-level value still displays would make the test actually verify which value is used.

A two-line comment explaining why the trigger differs from the icon-only dropdown summary conflicts with the project convention that treats comments as tech debt; it could be shortened to one line or moved into the test name instead.
